== Notes ==
* Consider using [[Fire Attunement]], [[Glowing Gaze]], and [[Glyph of Lesser Energy]] to compensate for this spell's high energy cost.
* Under [[Glyph of Immolation]], burning is applied to the target before the condition is checked for, so damage will be applied to target. Nearby foes will only suffer burning.
** [[Intensity]] can be used to perform half-damage to foes around target in addition to the previous action.
* If your target dies while you are casting Searing Flames, the spell will not [[fail]].
